title: Photo Gallery
name: Photo Gallery
description: A simple photo gallery to learn AWS S3 object storage
fulldescription: This beginner-friendly application teaches you the fundamentals of AWS S3 (Simple Storage Service) - the most essential AWS service for storing and retrieving files. Upload photos through a beautiful web interface, view them in a gallery, and learn how object storage works. Perfect for understanding buckets, objects, presigned URLs, and CORS configuration. This is the foundation you'll use in almost every AWS project.

services.name: S3
services.desc: Simple Storage Service - AWS's object storage for storing and retrieving any amount of data. Your photos are stored as 'objects' in 'buckets'.

services.name: Lambda
services.desc: Serverless compute that runs your code without managing servers. Handles photo uploads, lists, and deletions automatically.

services.name: API Gateway
services.desc: Creates RESTful APIs that connect your frontend to Lambda. Provides endpoints for photo operations with proper CORS support.
